designDecisions.sourceCoverageStrategy: The mission's source list (_sessions since 2026-07-20 [128 files], _inbox closes/checkpoints/postmortems in the same period [~5146 files], OPS-16 amendments A-080+, F-rows in OPS-19/21/23/24, dead-controls card, three assumption registers, ENFORCEMENT.md, the 24 unlanded OPS-23-wave-6 commits) is too large for one agent read serially inside a bounded session. Split into 6 parallel read-only sub-agents (fan model, one level deep, each prompt self-contained, each returns a structured per-instance inventory rather than prose): (1) OPS-16 A-080+ amendments + F-rows in OPS-19/21/23/24 + ENFORCEMENT.md + 61_enforcement_doctrine.md; (2) the three 2026-09-13 assumption registers + national-scale adversarial review + national program framework WDLL + the OPS-24 teardown review + the 13-stage map; (3) the 24 OPS-23-wave-6 commits (d23edddc^..efa64de5, confirmed by `git log --oneline | grep -i 'ops-23 wave 6'` = exactly 24), read via `git show` full commit bodies plus the close/checkpoint artifacts they cite; (4)+(5) _sessions/ split 2026-07-20..2026-08-20 and 2026-08-21..2026-09-16 (~64 files each); (6) Burnet/Bell/Milam county-specific fact pull (the seven named items in the dispatch) plus an _inbox/ sweep for postmortem/retrospective/handoff/pickup-shaped documents not already covered by 1-3, including the CTX planner retirement close's eleven blockers.
designDecisions.classificationFrame: Every sub-agent was given the same seven known classes (six CTX classes + the seventh from the third-party review) plus the named candidates from the dispatch (false earned states, stale copies overriding current, identity collisions across namespaces, controls that cannot fail, merged-but-not-deployed, serial discovery, deploy/traffic traps, stranded artifacts, duplicate row ids) and told to tag NEW candidates explicitly rather than force-fitting.
designDecisions.ownReadingBeforeFanning: Before dispatching sub-agents I read directly at source: _sessions/2026-09-10_MIDSESSION_ctx_completion_and_the_six_classes.md (the six classes, verbatim), _inbox/2026-09-10_ctx_third_party_review.md (the seventh class + 10 more ranked defects + a live-state table), _inbox/2026-09-13_dead_controls_ranked_fixes.md (7 controls-that-cannot-fail + 1 withdrawn + the absent-verified false-earned-state finding), 90_operations/OPS-24_county_to_serving_program.md (the 13-stage table, used to map every instance to a stage), ENFORCEMENT.md in full (named instances: the 2026-09-15 Bastrop 92.5% false-retirement mass-state-change, the 2026-08-20 CLOSE_OVERRIDE reason-ceremony log, the 2026-08-21 ten-wrong-statements set with 4 sub-instances), and _inbox/2026-09-13_coverage-sub_cp1.json (falsifier F5: the roster's NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY status is desynced from real data on 12 of 23 zoning-wired cities -- directly relevant to the Burnet unfixed-list item of the same name).
